title: The podman machine lost the size the owner chose
what: Set the machine back to the chosen size when no container runs, and make relay's setup or doctor name a machine smaller than the recorded choice, so a reset is seen.
why: The owner chose 10 CPUs and 20 GiB for the podman machine on 29 Oct; `podman machine list` on 30 Oct shows 6 CPUs and 8 GiB. Container gates measured on it run on fewer cores than decided.
failing_case: 30 Oct: `podman machine list` prints podman-machine-default ... 6 CPUs, 8GiB.
pass_cases: relay doctor names a machine below the chosen size.
